import urllib.request
from urllib.parse import quote
url = 'https://www.meteomanz.com/sy1?ty=hd&ind=33837&l=1&d1=18&m1=09&y1=2026&d2=18&m2=09&y2=2026&h1=03Z&h2=03Z&min=0&rt=0&ext=1'
HEADERS = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10) AppleWebKit/537.36', 'Referer': 'https://www.meteomanz.com/'}
print('=== DIRECT ===')
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=HEADERS)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
        print('OK', r.status, len(r.read()))
except Exception as e:
    print('FAIL', repr(e))
for proxy in ['https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=', 'https://corsproxy.io/?']:
    print('=== PROXY', proxy, '===')
    try:
        purl = proxy + quote(url, safe='')
        req = urllib.request.Request(purl, headers=HEADERS)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
            body = r.read()
            print('OK', r.status, len(body), body[:200])
    except Exception as e:
        print('FAIL', repr(e))
